instructions: Heat butter in a pan and add ginger-garlic paste
Add chopped onions and saute until golden
Add tomato puree and cook for 3-4 minutes
Add garam masala, turmeric, and chili powder
Add paneer cubes and cook for 2 minutes
Add cream and mix well
Simmer for 3-4 minutes
Garnish with fenugreek leaves and serve with naan or rice
Heat oil in a large pan
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chili
Add chopped onions and saute until translucent
Add potatoes and cauliflower florets
Add turmeric, chili powder, and coriander powder
Mix well and cover, cooking on medium heat for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking
Serve hot with roti or rice
Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 30 minutes
Grill or pan-fry until cooked
In a separate pan, saute onions and add ginger-garlic paste
Add tomato puree and spices
Add cooked chicken and cream
Simmer for 10 minutes
Boil lentils with turmeric until soft
In a pan, heat oil and add mustard seeds, let them crackle
Add cumin seeds, garlic, and dried chili
Add asafetida
Pour this tempering over cooked lentils
Mix well and serve with rice
Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes
Marinate meat in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 1 hour
In a heavy-bottomed pot, layer marinated meat and partially cooked rice
Add bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves between layers
Sprinkle ghee and mint leaves
Cover with foil and place lid on top
Cook on high heat for 2 minutes until steam forms, then cook on medium heat for 45 minutes
Let rest for 5 minutes before opening
Serve hot with raita and salad
Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 30 minutes
Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken pieces until golden brown
Remove chicken and set aside
In the same pan, add butter and cook tomato puree until oil separates
Add garam masala, chili powder, and turmeric
Add cooked chicken and cream
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens
Garnish with fenugreek leaves
Serve with naan or rice
